import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n, maxN = 1 << 20;
    static int[] f_arr = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] g_arr = new int[1 << 20];
    static double[][] prob_table = new double[21][21];
    static int[][] prob_int = new int[21][21];
    static int[] idx_0 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] idx_1 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] rev_map = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] match_arr = new int[21];
    static int[][] adj_mat = new int[21][21];

    static long mod_exp(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void compute(int[] output, List<Integer> left_nodes, List<Integer> right_nodes,
                        List<Integer> subgraphs, int[] index_map) {
        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int u : left_nodes) {
            for (int v : right_nodes) {
                edges.add(new int[]{u, v});
            }
        }

        int m = edges.size();
        for (int edge_mask = 0; edge_mask < (1 << m); ++edge_mask) {
            long rate = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                int u = edges.get(i)[0], v = edges.get(i)[1];
                if ((edge_mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    rate = (rate * prob_int[u][v]) % MOD;
                    adj_mat[u][v] = 1;
                } else {
                    rate = (rate * ((1 - prob_int[u][v] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    adj_mat[u][v] = 0;
                }
            }

            int new_mask = 0;
            for (int gr : subgraphs) {
                List<Integer> left_vec = new ArrayList<>(left_nodes);
                List<Integer> right_vec = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if ((gr & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        right_vec.add(i + n);
                    }
                }

                Collections.sort(right_vec);
                boolean found = false;
                Collections.sort(right_vec);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < left_vec.size(); ++i) {
                        if (adj_mat[left_vec.get(i)][right_vec.get(i)] == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(right_vec));
                if (found) {
                    new_mask |= (1 << index_map[gr]);
                }
            }

            output[new_mask] = (int)((output[new_mask] + rate) % MOD);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> arr) {
        int i = arr.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr.get(i) >= arr.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = arr.size() - 1;
        while (arr.get(j) <= arr.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        Collections.swap(arr, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(arr.subList(i + 1, arr.size()));
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                double val = Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());
                long inv100 = mod_exp(100, MOD - 2);
                prob_int[i][j + n] = (int)((val * inv100 % MOD) * 100 % MOD);
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(prob_int[0][1]);
            return;
        }

        int half1 = n / 2, half2 = n - half1;

        int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
        List<Integer> subset1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> subset2 = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == half1) {
                idx_0[mask] = cnt1;
                subset1.add(mask);
                cnt1++;
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == half2) {
                idx_1[mask] = cnt2;
                subset2.add(mask);
                cnt2++;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < cnt2; ++i) {
            int m = subset2.get(i);
            int complement = ((1 << n) - 1) ^ m;
            rev_map[i] = idx_0[complement];
        }

        List<Integer> l1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> l2 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> r = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; ++i) r.add(i);
        for (int i = 0; i < half1; ++i) l1.add(i);
        for (int i = half1; i < n; ++i) l2.add(i);

        compute(f_arr, l1, r, subset1, idx_0);
        compute(g_arr, l2, r, subset2, idx_1);

        int total1 = 1 << cnt1;
        for (int i = 0; i < cnt1; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < total1; ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f_arr[mask] = (int)((f_arr[mask] + f_arr[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        int total2 = 1 << cnt2;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < total2; ++mask) {
            int complement = total2 - 1 - mask;
            int rev_mask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < cnt2; ++i) {
                if ((complement & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    rev_mask |= (1 << rev_map[i]);
                }
            }

            int idx_val = (total1 - 1) ^ rev_mask;
            int weight = (1 - f_arr[idx_val] + MOD) % MOD;
            ans = (ans + 1L * weight * g_arr[mask]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(ans % MOD);
    }
}
